name: luch
description: Turn a conversation into source-backed work across public pages and the LUCH resources your account has selected.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to the LUCH tools available to your account. Research public pages, compare selected sources and, where granted, work with approved files or paired resources. Return with source links and a result you can inspect.
defaultPrompt: Compare these two public pages and give me a concise brief with direct source links.
Read the documents in my approved folder and identify the three main differences. Do not edit anything.
Show the LUCH tools actually available to my account and their current permission scope.
